threshold_upper_bounds.purpose: Post-hoc ranking/calibration diagnostic; cannot replace a registered threshold/checkpoint
threshold_upper_bounds.tie_rule: All events equal to threshold included; highest threshold among equal best IoU points

linear_negative_state_constant_current_g.assumptions: Constant negative current, 10ms step, no sign switch; finite asymptotic gain, not an assertion of divergence

interpretation_limits: One epoch and one seed diagnose this early failure; they do not establish asymptotic accuracy or statistical superiority.
Changing frozen-weight readout is a counterfactual, not an adapted trained architecture.
Negative background prototypes also occur for true positives; their sign alone cannot diagnose an error.
Current-only readout worsens SNN Dev IoU; history has useful information as well as extreme amplification.
The current grid input/architecture differ from H2-pro engineered causal features and bounded hidden MLP; the entire ANN gap cannot be attributed to spiking.
Continuous activity has no unit-spike AC interpretation; dense MAC remains an emulation cost, not power.

decision.quantization_conclusion: Removing rounding did not close the early accuracy gap; one epoch does not establish convergence or irrelevance of quantization
decision.stability_conclusion: Matched ANN passed the complete fixed-weight amplitude budget; old SNN still failed its preserved spike budget. This does not eliminate high-confidence background errors.
decision.calibration_conclusion: Exhaustive post-hoc threshold ceilings remain about 34.07% SNN / 34.15% ANN; finite grid choice cannot explain the H2-pro gap
decision.next_control: Change only the output-state update of the matched ANN to signed normalized leaky integration; keep stem/hidden, data, initial weights, optimizer and budget matched
decision.proposed_head_update: z_t = exp(-10/20)*z_(t-1) + (1-exp(-10/20))*I_t; no firing reset; same per-class prototype pooling and one-time bias
decision.readout_caveat: Unnormalized no-reset and normalized no-reset have nearly equal exhaustive-threshold IoU. Normalization is a scale choice, not evidence of a novel accuracy mechanism.
gates: Same-budget trained IoU and high-density Recall both improve over the matched ANN control; inspect precision and per-sequence FP explicitly
Final fixed weights pass known causal prefixes and all Train-main finite/amplitude checks, with healthy monitored training gradients; nonspiking head must retain explicit amplitude diagnostics
Only then consider a paired SNN head conversion; no new seeds or routing training yet
decision.fallback: If the readout control remains weak or only trades large FP growth for recall, pause the grid branch and prioritize a direct-conversion audit retaining H2-pro input features and MLP layer mapping
remaining_work_not_claimed_complete: Sparse execution and end-to-end MAC reduction
